name: @langwatch/identity-server
description: The server-side runtime of the identity platform (ADR-101, ADR-115): IdentityGuards, IdentityService, the verification ceremony, the backfill pass, the better-auth ceremonies and the storage ports they run on. Storage-engine-free: the app implements the repository interfaces with Prisma and the ledger port over its event-sourcing pipeline. The root export is better-auth-free; the ./better-auth subpath is the adapter that binds the ceremonies to better-auth's databaseHooks, and it is the only part that imports it.
